title: i-Series Modular Area + Decorative Lights
headline: Modular Solar Lighting System
intro: Solera Solar Lighting sets a new standard in solar lighting performance. i-Series delivers a year-round, configurable solar-powered lighting system engineered to provide bright, reliable illumination wherever you need it.
callouts: Configure the intelligent modular system to fit your application
It's not just lighting — it's visibility. Control. Data.
Recommended mounting height: Modular Area + Decorative Lights 20 ft – 30 ft

features.note: the X in the part number: 2 = Type 2, 3 = Type 3, 4 = Type 4, 5 = Type 5

tables.title: Modular Solar Area Light
notes: The catalog's CONFIGURATION column is one merged cell per model holding three labelled values (LIGHT HEAD / SOLAR PANELS / BATTERY); they are split into three columns here.
X in the part number = optics: 2 = Type 2, 3 = Type 3, 4 = Type 4, 5 = Type 5.
Hybrid (sun glyph) marks the -HYB part numbers. -OG is not expanded anywhere on pages 56/58; the page 56 footer reads HYBRID + OFF-GRID, so -OG presumably = off-grid (inferred, not printed).
No bold (factory-default) CCT is marked in the FlexColor cells.
Battery is printed 600WH / 1200WH in this table and 600Wh / 1200Wh in the page 56 configuration key.
This table has no Listings column.

tables.title: Modular Solar Decorative Light
notes: Part number printed with a hyphen before DB1 (03006X4-DB1), unlike the area-light part numbers (…X4DB1); transcribed as printed.
X in the part number = optics: 2 = Type 2, 3 = Type 3, 4 = Type 4, 5 = Type 5.

footnotes: * 10-year warranty available at an additional cost.
Hybrid = -HYB part numbers; X in the part number = optics: 2 = Type 2, 3 = Type 3, 4 = Type 4, 5 = Type 5
Recommended mounting height, Modular Area + Decorative Lights: 20 ft – 30 ft. See pages 68 + 69 for pole recommendations.
Page footer: SOLERA SOLAR / HYBRID + OFF-GRID (page 56) and SOLERA SOLAR / i-SERIES (page 58).

It's not just lighting — it's visibility. Control. Data.
extras.text: Designed for intelligent control, each i-Series product integrates seamlessly to Solera CONNECT. Through 4G connectivity and intuitive web and mobile access, remotely program, manage and monitor performance — adjust operating schedules, customize lighting profiles, and respond to alerts across your entire portfolio — anytime, from anywhere.
